# Every coding agent, every machine, one command center | Autonomous Harness
## Channel: Autonomous
9.29K subscribers
2 likes

### Description
67 views
Posted: 2026-10-15
Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud. Harness puts every coding agent in one command center and lets you answer them from your phone.

Every agent gets its own pane and its own branch, side by side in one command center. Close the app and your agents keep working. When one needs you, your phone pings: tap yes, or just say the next task.

Harness is free and open source for Mac and Linux, with iOS and Android apps. It works with 14 coding agents on your own accounts, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi and Hermes. No SSH keys, no VPN, end-to-end encrypted.
